tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window and page ground. Text sits on it in ink and muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, popups, toolbars and buttons that rest on bg. Text on it: ink, muted, primary, accent, danger.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: inputs, selects, slider track, capture buttons. Text on it: ink and muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edge of every control (input, select, button, checkbox, slider track). 3:1 or better on bg, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, titles and icons. Reads at 14:1 or better on bg, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, slider end labels, file details. 7:1 or better on bg, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: ImageShot blue: primary button fill, links, slider fill, focus ring, selected tool edge. Also usable as text on bg, surface and primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Hover and selected background for capture buttons and tools. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover. White on the light blue, deep navy on the dark theme's pale blue.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm amber for the live value (resolution percentage), the region size readout and highlights. Text on bg, surface and accent-soft at 4.9:1 or better.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft amber ground for a callout or a highlighted row. Text on it: ink or accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a filled accent chip.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, error toast fill and destructive actions. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: toast
tokens.usage: Toast and capture-toolbar ground; the inverse of bg so it floats over any page.

tokens.name: on-toast
tokens.usage: Text on toast.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px outline with 2px offset. 3:1 or better on bg, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Crop and draw stage behind the screenshot. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: mark-red
tokens.usage: Annotation ink: arrows, rectangles and step numbers. Same in both themes so a shared screenshot looks the same.

tokens.name: mark-amber
tokens.usage: Annotation ink for highlighter and callouts. Differs from mark-red in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: mark-blue
tokens.usage: Annotation ink for neutral pointers.

tokens.name: mark-black
tokens.usage: Annotation ink for text on light screenshots.

tokens.name: mark-white
tokens.usage: Annotation ink for text on dark screenshots; always with the selection outline.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Window and page titles with the logo.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Popup header next to the mark.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: File details and slider end labels.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Pixel sizes and coordinates in the region selector, for example 1920 × 1080.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between tool buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between capture buttons; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; capture grid padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card side padding; window padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Permission and clipboard window padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a window.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Crop handles and the text-box edit field.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Drawing tool buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, selects, inputs and capture buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and screenshot tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toasts, slider track and thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toast floating over the page.

tokens.name: shadow-shot
tokens.usage: A screenshot thumbnail on its checker frame.

tokens.name: shadow-stage
tokens.usage: The image on the crop and draw stage.
